Coram : VIKRAM NATH
Issue for Consideration Matter pertains to conviction of the appellant for offences punishable u/s. 323/34 IPC and imposition of three months imprisonment, as also conviction u/s. 325/34 IPC and imposition of one year imprisonment with Rs 500/- fine which was modified to three months imprisonment the High Court. Headnotes Sentence/Sentencing – Reduction of sentence – Conviction of the appellant for offences punishable u/s. 323/34 and u/s. 325/34 – Imposition of three months imprisonment and one year imprisonment with Rs 500/- fine respectively – High Court modified
Decision Date : 05-02-2024 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 748/2024 | Bench : 1 Judge
